answer: The blaster climbs to the slope's vertex above a relic corridor and files a shot plan naming that vertex, the charge and the window. Weight vests only with one state explosives permit: a course, an exam, 180 days of supervised blasts from a relic powder-magazine, one jade-tagged permit each. Each fake costs one trainee, 1,600 units and 180 days; 100 fakes cost 160,000 units and 18,000 blaster-days. Cheapest cheat: hiring a licensed blaster to lend their permit — the lender surrenders the permit backing their identity and risks prosecution, and a forged jade tag fails the registry.
